name: Britannia gol maal
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Refined Palm & Palmolein Oil, Sugar (20.5%), Raising Agents [503(Ii), 500(Ii) & 341(I)], Cumin Black (Kalonji) (0.9%), Iodised Salt, Invert Sugar Syrup, Milk Solids, Emulsifiers [322(I) & 471], Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Dough Conditioner (223), Improver [1101(I)] And Colour (102).
